title: Decomposition of the approved design into independent work packages (C1). Each module is built in its own lane from D1 to E2; the modules are then merged and F1 verifies the whole against this plan. See agents/pipeline-build-agent.md.

path.description: Repository-relative, forward slashes, no glob: a file, or a directory when it ends in `/`. No absolute path and no `..`. Code checks the rest (no two modules' paths overlap, none inside the protected trees).

manifest_hash.description: Copied from the pinned context manifest.

candidate_digest.description: Copied from the sealed design decision: the design this plan decomposes.

requirements.description: The requirements of the approved design, with ids assigned here. Every module and every test refers to them; code builds the coverage matrix from these ids.

source.description: Where in the approved design this requirement comes from (a component, decision or contract).

interfaces.description: The only ways modules meet. Each has one provider and a frozen contract; a module sees another module's interface through its contract, never through its code.

contract_ref.description: The frozen contract file that states it.

component.description: The component of the approved design this module realizes.

implementation_paths.description: The only paths E1 may write for this module. Disjoint across modules.

consumes.description: Interface ids this module uses from other modules.

verification.description: Methods the tests of this module add to the checks of policy/ci.yaml. A module can only raise its obligations; it never waives a required check.
